images.name: table-edge-opp.png
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-background.
Asset type: wide background strip for the OPPONENT's far edge of a game table (top of the screen), table-edge-opp.png.
Output: PNG, exactly 2400x800 pixels, 3:1 landscape.

STYLE:
Hand-painted gouache illustration with visible brushstrokes and slightly rough paper grain, in the same series as a set of storybook creature cards. Composition borrows from Japanese woodblock prints: flat layered planes of color, bold simple silhouettes, generous negative space. This is a quiet BACKGROUND texture for a game table, not a picture to look at: large simple shapes only, very low contrast between neighbouring shapes, no focal point, no small details.
Palette (cool, the opponent's side): dark slate (#2a3346), steel blue (#4f78a8), pale ice (#e6ecf4), with a little cool silver (#c2cbe0). No purple, no warm colors.

SCENE:
A distant range of night mountains seen across a table, as layered flat woodblock silhouettes: two or three overlapping ridgelines in slate and steel blue, the farthest palest. A calm dark night sky above them along the very top edge, with a few tiny, faint stars. Soft bands of mist between the ridges.

LAYOUT (top to bottom):
- Top 15%: night sky.
- 15% to 60%: the mountain ridgelines.
- Bottom 40%: an almost flat, very pale ice (#e6ecf4) area with only faint mist texture, so it can fade smoothly into the table. Nothing important in the bottom 40%.

RESPONSIVE CROP (important): the image is shown full width on desktop (about 3:1) and cropped to the CENTER THIRD on phones. So the shapes must run evenly across the whole width, and the center third must look complete and balanced on its own. No important shape near the left or right edges.

AVOID:
photorealism, 3D render look, glossy shading, smooth airbrushed gradients, HDR glow, bokeh, lens flare, bright highlights, high contrast, small detailed objects, creatures, animals, people, buildings, text, letters, logos, frames, borders, watermarks, signatures, a single focal point, anything placed only at the far left or far right.
